obd.connectSubtitle: ELM327 BLE adapters — read codes and live sensors, then diagnose in Chat.
obd.step1: Plug the adapter into the OBD-II port (usually under the dash, left of the steering column).
obd.step2: Turn the ignition ON (engine can stay off). Wait for the adapter LED.
obd.step3: Tap Connect and pick your adapter in the system Bluetooth list.
obd.step4: We read stored/pending DTCs and basic sensors, then open diagnosis in Chat.
obd.bleOnlyNote: Classic Bluetooth (non-BLE) dongles are not supported in the browser. Prefer adapters labeled BLE / 4.0+.
obd.workingHint: Keep the phone near the adapter. Do not leave this screen.
obd.noCodes: No stored or pending codes reported.
obd.errorGeneric: OBD connection or read failed. Try again.
